words.name: Build and grow
words.blurb: Markets, culture, and the Steward who builds for you.
words.opening: Land pays, and land you've built on pays more. You hold half of The Deep Wilds. Take the rest, then make it worth keeping.
words.goal: Hold all of The Deep Wilds, with a market finished and culture 1 on any of it, by turn 4.
words.met: The Deep Wilds is yours, with a market and culture 1
hints: Tap Mistbury, then Spend: a market costs 6 gold and pays 2 a turn. It's ready at the end of this turn.
Culture 1 costs 3 gold under Spend. Each level defends 6% better and pays 1 gold, but it's lost if the land is taken.
Your Steward runs the realm with a share of your income, building and raising culture for you. The Leaders panel sets its share.
words.closing: Gold comes in every turn now, a little more than before. That's the whole economy, more or less.
